Call to Register: AI & Digital Transformation Specialists Bring your digital expertise to the United Nations Volunteers (UNV) Global Talent Pool! UNV invites experienced professionals across the Caribbean to register their profiles for consideration for potential future UNV opportunities supporting digital transformation and sustainable development. Professional backgrounds of interest: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Digital Transformation and Digital Public Infrastructure Digital Government and Public Sector Innovation Technology Project Management Business Analysis and Digital Service Design AI Solution Development and Deployment Solutions Architecture and Systems Integration Who should register? Professionals with relevant qualifications or demonstrated experience in digital technologies, artificial intelligence, technology project implementation or related fields. Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills are particularly valuable. What are the benefits of becoming a UN Volunteer? Depending on the assignment type and applicable conditions, UN Volunteers may receive: A monthly Living Allowance (VLA) to support living expenses. Medical, life and disability insurance coverage. Entry and exit allowances, where applicable. Access to learning and professional development opportunities. Valuable experience contributing to sustainable development alongside United Nations entities. Register your profile: https://app.unv.org/ Important: This is a call for registration in UNV's Global Talent Pool, not an advertisement for a currently available assignment. Registration does not guarantee selection or deployment. Specific eligibility criteria will depend on future opportunities. Ref: CJ-UNV-AI-2026 Log in or register to apply
